## What it is

A 72 × 18 × 12 mm bar with four 10 mm deep holes at the `hole_block` clearances: 0.2, 0.35, 0.5 and 1.0 mm per side. The notched corner marks the 0.2 mm end, and the clearance goes up hole by hole from there. Push the printed peg into each hole to find which one gives the fit you're after on your printer, then print that `hole_block` variant.

## Design notes

Same lead-in and hole construction as `hole_block`, so a hole that fits here fits there, for a fraction of the plastic (11.4 cm³ against 87.9 cm³).

## Don't

- Don't add text labels. The notch and the hole order carry which hole is which.
- Don't polish the holes or their lead-ins (fit geometry, as on `hole_block`).
